python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,sys,time,re,os
def run(argv,timeout=35):
 return subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
def val(*argv):
 p=run(argv,12)
 if p.returncode:raise RuntimeError('INSPECT_FAILED')
 return p.stdout.strip()
name='deploy-gaybbs-1'
tag='gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local'
new='gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:search-color-5a93de6'
old='gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-search-colors-20261114'
active=val('docker','inspect',name,'--format','{{.Image}}')
if val('docker','inspect',name,'--format','{{.State.Running}}')!='true':sys.exit(61)
if active!=val('docker','image','inspect',tag,'--format','{{.Id}}'):sys.exit(62)
newid=val('docker','image','inspect',new,'--format','{{.Id}}')
if active==newid:sys.exit(0)
files=[x.strip() for x in val('docker','inspect',name,'--format','{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}').split(',') if x.strip()]
if len(files)!=2 or not os.path.isfile(files[0]):sys.exit(63)
base=['docker','compose','-f',files[0],'-p','deploy']
current_hash=val('docker','inspect',name,'--format','{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.config-hash"}}')
if current_hash not in val(*(base+['config','--hash','gaybbs'])):sys.exit(64)
if run(['docker','tag',active,old]).returncode:sys.exit(65)
if run(['docker','tag',new,tag]).returncode:sys.exit(66)
p=run(base+['up','-d','--no-deps','gaybbs'],90)
if p.returncode:
 err=p.stderr+'\n'+p.stdout
 run(['docker','tag',old,tag])
 rollback=run(base+['up','-d','--no-deps','gaybbs'],90)
 if rollback.returncode or val('docker','inspect',name,'--format','{{.State.Running}}')!='true':sys.exit(150)
 cases=[
  (101,r'container name.*already in use|Conflict.*container name'),
  (102,r'failed to create shim task|OCI runtime create failed|runc create failed'),
  (103,r'operation not permitted|permission denied|access denied'),
  (104,r'failed to mount|mount source path|invalid mount config'),
  (105,r'no such file or directory|file not found|secret.*not found'),
  (106,r'network.*not found|network.*failed'),
  (107,r'failed to bind host port|port is already allocated'),
  (108,r'driver failed programming external connectivity'),
  (109,r'read-only file system'),
  (110,r'not a directory'),
  (111,r'container .* is not running|container .* is restarting'),
  (112,r'no space left|disk quota'),
  (113,r'image.*not found|manifest unknown'),
  (114,r'healthcheck|unhealthy|dependency failed'),
  (115,r'failed to create container|cannot create container'),
  (116,r'cannot stop container|failed to stop container'),
  (117,r'failed to remove container|cannot remove container'),
  (118,r'context canceled|request canceled'),
  (119,r'no such container'),
  (120,r'container .* marked for removal'),
  (121,r'Error response from daemon'),
 ]
 for code,pat in cases:
  if re.search(pat,err,re.I):sys.exit(code)
 sys.exit(122)
time.sleep(5)
if val('docker','inspect',name,'--format','{{.Image}}')!=newid or val('docker','inspect',name,'--format','{{.State.Running}}')!='true':
 run(['docker','tag',old,tag]);run(base+['up','-d','--no-deps','gaybbs'],90)
 sys.exit(151)
